paragraph:
The price of picturesque
A port discovers that selling its past is easier than securing its future

In the fictional port of Bellhaven, a restored (turret) overlooks a working dock, a (minaret) and an abandoned warehouse. The mayor calls this an opportunity to (knit) the town together. A (shipwright) calls it an opportunity to charge him for parking. Both understand something about urban renewal.

Bellhaven is (beset) by expensive housing and declining employment. Its councillors hope visitors will (offset) the loss of (freight) business. Their central (tenet) is plausible: an attractive town should be able to (exploit) its history. The danger lies in assuming that a hotel receipt measures everything worth preserving.

The council's (draft) plan divides the waterfront into a cultural quarter and a commercial district. An income (bracket) determines eligibility for subsidised workshops. A new authority will (solicit) investors, (delimit) conservation zones and transfer a share of rental income to a housing fund. Its (remit) is broad enough to invite ambition and vague enough to excuse failure.

Consider the old customs house. Workers have repaired its (parquet), secured a loose iron support and polished a display (cabinet). Inside sit a soldier's (epaulet), a merchant's (bracelet) and a (musket). One patron wants the last item removed. Another wants to (cosset) visitors with stories of commerce untroubled by coercion. History is proving less compliant than the floorboards.

A ledger records a trader's decision to (manumit) an enslaved servant. Beside it, an exhibition explains the distinction between what was (licit) and what was just. The museum should neither imply that every merchant was (upright) nor use one generous act to erase an industry’s cruelties. A (forthright) account may (discomfit) donors. That is a service, not a curatorial error.

Elsewhere, authenticity has become a manufacturing process. One shop sells a (counterfeit) naval medal as an original; another describes every imported (trinket) as local craft. Investigators must (sift) invoices to separate (illicit) sales from harmless imitation. The difference is (deceit), not whether a souvenir pleases a historian. An (airtight) provenance claim needs more than an old-looking label.

Real workshops are less photogenic. An apprentice learns to set a (rivet); a toolmaker replaces an axe's (haft). Above them, a musician rents a (garret), while a furniture restorer occupies a (loft). These people (inhabit) the heritage that investors (covet). Convert every workroom into accommodation and the town becomes a stage from which the cast has been evicted.

Preservation and enterprise can (cohabit), but not by magic. Noise limits may (inhibit) production; restaurant deliveries can obstruct repairs. The council's (tacit) bargain has favoured visitors over residents. Its contracts should make that preference (explicit), rather than bury it in the (implicit) assumption that higher property values benefit everyone.

The opening celebrations offer a miniature of the problem. A (quartet) performs a (minuet), followed by a (duet) for (cornet) and piano. Officials (trumpet) the recovery. At a (banquet), a visiting (gourmet) praises a fish (fillet) cooked in a (skillet), then a roast (pullet). The chef receives a (bouquet); the housing officer receives a petition.

A comic (skit) supplies the evening's best economics. An actor playing a (spendthrift) mayor buys a gold-plated (tourniquet) to stop the budget bleeding. The joke wins a (plaudit) from an otherwise (distrait) financier. Such (deft) satire does not alter the (deficit) by a (whit), but it does puncture the (conceit) that expensive festivities are an investment merely because officials enjoy them.

Bellhaven's prospects also depend on less theatrical details. A blocked (outlet) sends a (rivulet) through a basement after heavy rain. At the (onset) of winter, a (snowdrift) can close the uphill road. Summer (drought) threatens the park. Calling each disruption an unforeseeable (backset) is easier than paying for drainage and maintenance. Yet (foresight) is chiefly the willingness to budget for boring things.

The park's attractions are modest: a (violet) with a (droplet) on its petals, a (cygnet) beside its parent, an occasional (eaglet) on a conservation centre's camera. A promotional film turns these into a (surfeit) of soaring music and slow-motion (flight). Visitors may forgive the artistic (sleight) of hand. Residents will be less forgiving if advertising absorbs the money needed to keep the paths open.

Nor is the district a social blank slate. A (cleft) in the old seawall separates two neighbourhoods; an income (rift) separates them more effectively. Families left (bereft) of affordable homes see regeneration as a polite word for removal. A policy that ignores this will (elicit) resentment, (albeit) after the ribbon-cutting photographs have been filed away.

The administration's response has been (fraught). One (maladroit) official dismissed a tenant as a (hermit) for declining to welcome weekend crowds. A more (adroit) colleague proposed longer leases and relocation payments. It would be (daft) to promise that nobody must ever move. It is equally foolish to treat displacement as a (slight) inconvenience borne by somebody else.

There are legitimate worries about (graft). A developer has cultivated councillors while seeking a discount. The arrangement may be legal, but the appearance of favouritism is an enduring (blight). Independent (oversight) should test valuations before contracts are signed. Putting disclosures in a digital (closet), technically available but practically undiscoverable, is not transparency.

The mayor's brisk (gait) and talent for reassurance remain political assets. Her least useful (trait) is to regard scrutiny as hostility. After an (onslaught) of questions, she called her critics (overwrought). Yet the changes already (wrought) by redevelopment deserve scrutiny. A hidden subsidy does not become free because nobody sends the town an invoice.

A better settlement would (split) commercial risk more honestly, preserve workshops and publish the cost of each subsidy. It would also (transmit) something beyond a marketable image: the skills, disagreements and habits that made Bellhaven distinctive. A waterfront need not resemble a (sonnet) to deserve protection. Sometimes a noisy, useful (bit) of town is worth more than a perfect view.
translation:
如画风景的代价
一座港口发现，兜售过去比保障未来容易

在虚构的港口贝尔黑文，一座修复后的(角楼)俯瞰着仍在运转的码头、一座(宣礼塔)和一间废弃仓库。市长称，这是将小镇(联结)起来的机会。一位(造船工匠)则说，这是向他收取停车费的机会。两人都懂得一些城市更新的道理。

贝尔黑文受到高房价和就业萎缩的(困扰)。议员们希望游客能够(抵消)(货运)业务流失造成的损失。他们的核心(信条)听起来颇有道理：一座有吸引力的小镇，理应能够(利用)自身的历史。危险在于，以为一张酒店收据就能衡量所有值得保留的东西。

议会的规划(草案)将滨水区划分为文化街区和商业区。收入(档次)决定谁有资格租用受补贴的工坊。一个新机构将负责(招募)投资者、(划定)保护区，并把部分租金收入转入住房基金。它的(职权范围)足够宽泛，可以激发雄心；又足够模糊，可以替失败开脱。

看看旧海关大楼便知。工人修复了(镶木地板)，加固了松动的铁支架，还擦亮了一个陈列(柜)。里面摆着一枚军人的(肩章)、一只商人的(手镯)和一支(滑膛枪)。一位赞助人要求撤掉最后那件展品。另一位则希望用毫无强迫交易阴影的商业故事来(宠惯)游客。事实证明，历史没有地板那么听话。

一本账簿记录了一位商人决定(释放奴隶)的往事，获释者是他的仆人。旁边的展览解释了当时(合法的)行为与正义行为之间的区别。博物馆既不该暗示每位商人都(正直)，也不该用一次慷慨之举抹去一个行业的残酷。一种(直率的)叙述或许会让捐赠者(难堪)。这是博物馆应有的贡献，而不是策展失误。

在其他地方，真实性已经变成一道制造工序。一家商店把(伪造的)海军勋章当作真品出售；另一家则把每件进口(小饰物)都说成本地工艺品。调查人员必须(筛查)发票，区分(非法的)销售与无害的仿制。区别在于是否存在(欺骗)，而不在于纪念品是否讨历史学家喜欢。关于来源的说法要做到(无懈可击)，仅靠一张显旧的标签可不够。

真正的工坊没有那么上镜。一个学徒正在学习安装(铆钉)；一位工具匠在更换斧子的(柄)。楼上，一名音乐家租住在(顶楼小屋)，一位家具修复师则占用着一间(阁楼)。这些人(栖居于)投资者所(觊觎)的历史遗产之中。若把每间工坊都改成住宿设施，小镇就会成为一座演员已遭驱逐的舞台。

保护与经营可以(共处)，但不能指望魔法。噪声限制可能(抑制)生产，餐厅送货也可能妨碍维修。议会与各方达成的(默契)一直偏向游客，而非居民。合同应当把这种偏好(明确)写出来，而不是将其藏在房产升值有益于所有人这一(隐含的)假设里。

开幕庆典提供了这一问题的缩影。一支(四重奏乐团)演奏了(小步舞曲)，随后是(短号)与钢琴的(二重奏)。官员们(大肆宣扬)经济复苏。在一场(宴会)上，一位来访的(美食家)先称赞了用(平底煎锅)烹制的鱼(片)，随后又赞美了烤(小母鸡)。厨师收到一束(鲜花)，住房官员收到一份请愿书。

一出滑稽(短剧)贡献了当晚最出色的经济学见解。演员扮演一位(挥霍无度的)市长，买来镀金(止血带)，试图阻止预算失血。这个笑话赢得了一位原本(心不在焉的)金融家的(喝彩)。这种(巧妙的)讽刺无法让(赤字)减少(一丁点)，却戳破了这样一种(自负的想法)：昂贵的庆典只因官员喜欢，就能算作投资。

贝尔黑文的前景也取决于一些不那么戏剧化的细节。一个堵塞的(排水口)，会在暴雨后让一股(细流)穿过地下室。冬季(来临)时，一堆(风积雪)就能封住上山的道路。夏季(干旱)威胁着公园。把每次中断都称为不可预见的(挫折)，总比掏钱修排水设施和做维护容易。然而，所谓(远见)，主要就是愿意为枯燥的事情编列预算。

公园的看点并不起眼：一朵花瓣上挂着(水珠)的(紫罗兰)，一只依偎在亲鸟身旁的(小天鹅)，以及保护中心摄像头里偶尔出现的(雏鹰)。宣传片却把这些变成了(过量的)激昂音乐和慢镜头(飞翔)。游客或许会原谅这种艺术性的(障眼法)。但如果宣传费吞掉了维持步道开放所需的资金，居民就不会那么宽容了。

这个街区也并非一张社会关系的白纸。旧海堤上的一道(裂口)隔开了两个社区；收入(鸿沟)将它们分隔得更加彻底。那些(失去)可负担住房的家庭，觉得“更新”不过是驱离的客气说法。忽视这一点的政策将会(引起)怨恨，(尽管)届时剪彩照片可能早已归档。

政府的应对一直(充满紧张)。一名(笨拙的)官员，仅仅因为一位租户不愿欢迎周末人潮，就把他斥为(隐士)。一位更(机敏的)同僚则提出延长租期并提供搬迁补偿。承诺任何人永远都不用搬家，是(愚蠢的)。把迁离当成由别人承担的(轻微的)不便，同样愚蠢。

人们对(贪腐)的担忧并非毫无根据。一位开发商一边争取折扣，一边拉拢议员。这种安排或许合法，但偏袒的观感会成为持久的(污点)。独立(监督)应在合同签署前检验估值。把披露信息塞进数字(壁橱)，让它理论上可以获取、实际上无从查找，算不上透明。

市长轻快的(步态)和安抚人心的本领，依然是政治资产。她最无益的(特点)，是把审查视为敌意。面对一轮问题的(猛攻)，她称批评者(过度激动)。然而，重建已经(造成)的变化理应接受审视。隐性补贴不会因为没人向小镇寄来账单，就变得免费。

更好的安排应当更诚实地(分担)商业风险，保留工坊，并公布每项补贴的成本。它还应当(传承)某些超越可售卖形象的东西：使贝尔黑文与众不同的技艺、分歧和习惯。一片滨水区不必像一首(十四行诗)，才值得保护。有时，小镇上一(小块)嘈杂而实用的地方，比完美的风景更有价值。

本批词根亮点：

• -mit 家族：submit/commit/transmit/emit/remit/manumit/permit，全来自拉丁 mittere（送）；manumit（解放奴隶）=用手放开送走

• explode：原意是"鼓掌将演员轰下台"（ex+plode），后来才变成"爆炸"

• plaudit/applaud/explode：全来自拉丁 plaudere（鼓掌），一个动作衍生出截然不同的词义

• adroit/maladroit：来自法语"右手"（droit），和 dexterous（右手灵巧）、sinister（左/邪恶）形成三角关系

• spendthrift：spend+thrift（节约），把节约都花掉了=挥霍者，词源逻辑一目了然

• hermit/hermetically：希腊"荒漠居民"，hermetically sealed（密封的）=像隐士一样与世隔绝

• wright：古英语"工匠"，shipwright/playwright/wheelwright，专业工匠的通用后缀

quiz.question: ___ bracket
quiz.explanation: 括号; 等级, 税级. High earners fall into a higher tax bracket. 高收入者属于更高的税级。 | bracket->托架（西班牙语bragueta->短裤/支架），bracket->托架/等级括号（cf. brace支撑，embrace拥抱，bracket支架） || 文化联想：中国个人所得税按收入落入不同税率档位，最适合帮助记忆 bracket，可以说 **a tax bracket — “As taxable income rises, part of a worker’s income may fall into a higher tax bracket.”**

quiz.question: _____ trinket
quiz.explanation: 小饰品; 小玩意, 廉价小饰品. She bought a cheap trinket as a souvenir. 她买了一个廉价小饰品作为纪念品。 | trinket->小装饰品（来源不明，可能来自trink->饮酒用具），trinket->不值钱的小玩意（cf. knick-knack小摆设） || 文化联想：中国景区里几块钱的小挂件和钥匙扣最适合帮助记忆 trinket，可以说 **a cheap trinket — “A tourist may buy a cheap trinket at a scenic spot simply as a small reminder of the trip.”**

quiz.question: _________ musket
quiz.explanation: 火枪, 燧发枪. Colonial soldiers carried a flintlock musket into battle. 殖民地士兵带着燧发枪进入战斗。 | moschetto->燕子/小火枪（意大利语，因枪嘴形似燕子），musket->火枪（cf. mosquito蚊子，musketeer火枪手） || 文化联想：musket 是早期西式火枪，可用中国学生参观近代战争博物馆时来记忆，可以说 **a flintlock musket — “At a museum on nineteenth-century warfare, students may see a flintlock musket displayed beside other early firearms.”**

quiz.question: ____ bracelet
quiz.explanation: 手镯, 金手镯. She wore an elegant gold bracelet on her wrist. 她手腕上戴着一只优雅的金手镯。 | bracel->手臂（拉丁brachium），bracelet->套在手臂上的=手镯（cf. brace支撑，embrace拥抱=用手臂围住） || 文化联想：中国人熟悉的玉手镯最适合帮助记忆 bracelet，可以说 **a jade bracelet — “A grandmother may pass a jade bracelet down to her granddaughter as a family keepsake.”**

quiz.question: eaglet __ ____
quiz.explanation: 小鹰, 巢中的小鹰. The eaglet in nest waited for its parents to return. 巢中的小鹰等待父母归来。 | eagle->鹰（拉丁aquila），let->小的后缀，eaglet->小鹰（cf. piglet小猪，droplet小水滴，booklet小册子） || 文化联想：中国自然保护区里巢中等待亲鸟喂食的小鹰最适合帮助记忆 eaglet，可以说 **a young eaglet — “A young eaglet may remain in the nest while its parents bring food back from the surrounding mountains.”**

quiz.question: ____ fillet
quiz.explanation: 鱼片; 肉片, 牛肉片. The chef prepared a tender beef fillet for dinner. 厨师为晚餐准备了嫩的牛肉片。 | filet->细线/条（法语，filum->线），fillet->切成细条的肉/鱼片（cf. file文件/线状，profile轮廓线） || 文化联想：中国餐桌上的无刺鱼排最适合帮助记忆 fillet，可以说 **a fish fillet — “A cook may pan-fry a boneless fish fillet with ginger and scallions for dinner.”**

quiz.question: ____ skillet
quiz.explanation: 平底锅, 铁平底锅. She cooked eggs in a cast iron skillet. 她在铸铁平底锅里煎鸡蛋。 | scutella->浅碟（拉丁），skillet->浅的平底锅（cf. scuttle桶/逃跑，skill技能，skillet平底锅） || 文化联想：中国家庭用铸铁平底锅煎饺最适合帮助记忆 skillet，可以说 **a cast-iron skillet — “A cook may use a cast-iron skillet to fry dumplings until their bottoms become crisp and golden.”**

quiz.question: _____ pullet
quiz.explanation: 小母鸡, 年轻的小母鸡. The farmer raised a young pullet for egg production. 农民养了一只年轻的小母鸡用于产蛋。 | poule->母鸡（法语，拉丁pulla->雌性幼禽），pullet->小母鸡（cf. poultry家禽，poulard阉母鸡） || 文化联想：中国农家院里还很年轻的小母鸡最适合帮助记忆 pullet，可以说 **a young pullet — “A farmer may raise a young pullet until it is mature enough to begin laying eggs.”**

quiz.question: _______ violet
quiz.explanation: 紫罗兰, 非洲紫罗兰. The African violet blooms year-round indoors. 非洲紫罗兰在室内全年开花。 | viola->紫色（拉丁），violet->紫色的花=紫罗兰（cf. viola中提琴，violence暴力=紫色/激烈，ultraviolet紫外线） || 文化联想：中国家庭窗台上常见的紫罗兰盆栽最适合帮助记忆 violet，可以说 **an African violet — “An African violet can bloom indoors for long periods when it receives the right light and care.”**

quiz.question: _____ droplet
quiz.explanation: 小水滴, 水滴. A water droplet clung to the leaf. 一滴水珠附着在叶子上。 | drop->滴，let->小，droplet->小水滴（cf. drop下落，teardrop泪滴，drop-off下降） || 文化联想：荷叶上的一颗露珠最适合帮助记忆 droplet，可以说 **a water droplet — “A single water droplet may rest on a lotus leaf like a tiny glass bead after rain.”**

quiz.question: _____ outlet
quiz.explanation: 出口; 插座, 电源插座. Plug the charger into the power outlet. 把充电器插入电源插座。 | out->向外，let->通道/出口（古英语lettan），outlet->向外流出的通道=出口/插座（cf. inlet进口，inlet vs. outlet） || 文化联想：中国家庭墙上的电源插座最适合帮助记忆 outlet，可以说 **a power outlet — “A traveler may plug a phone charger into a power outlet beside the hotel bed.”**

quiz.question: ________ epaulet
quiz.explanation: 肩章, 军用肩章. The generals uniform featured ornate military epaulet. 将军的制服上有华丽的军用肩章。 | epaule->肩膀（法语），epaulet->肩膀上的装饰=肩章（cf. shoulder肩膀，epaulette法式拼写，pauldron肩甲） || 文化联想：中国仪仗队军服上的装饰性肩章最适合帮助记忆 epaulet，可以说 **a military epaulet — “A ceremonial uniform may have an ornate military epaulet decorating each shoulder.”**

quiz.question: ________ rivulet
quiz.explanation: 小溪; 细流, 山间小溪. A mountain rivulet flowed down the hillside. 山间小溪从山坡上流下。 | rivus->小溪（拉丁），rivulet->小小溪流（cf. river河流，rival竞争者=用同一条河的人，riviera海滨） || 文化联想：中国山谷里从石缝流下的细小溪流最适合帮助记忆 rivulet，可以说 **a mountain rivulet — “After spring rain, a mountain rivulet may trickle down the hillside and join a larger stream.”**

quiz.question: gourmet _______
quiz.explanation: 美食家; 美食的, 美食. The restaurant specializes in gourmet cuisine. 这家餐厅专门提供美食。 | gourmand->吃货（法语），gourmet->精于品鉴美食的人=美食家（cf. gourmand贪吃者，gourmet精食家，更讲究） || 文化联想：成都、广州等美食城市里的资深食客最适合帮助记忆 gourmet，可以说 **a gourmet diner — “A gourmet diner may travel across Chengdu to compare different styles of Sichuan cuisine.”**

quiz.question: ____ tenet
quiz.explanation: 原则; 信条, 核心原则. Freedom is a core tenet of democracy. 自由是民主的核心原则。 | tenet->他持有（拉丁tenere->持有，第三人称），tenet->被持守的信念=原则（cf. retain保留，tenure任期，tenacious顽强） || 文化联想：“己所不欲，勿施于人”可以作为行为原则来帮助记忆 tenet，可以说 **a moral tenet — “‘Do not impose on others what you do not desire yourself’ can be treated as a moral tenet about reciprocal conduct.”**

quiz.question: cygnet ____
quiz.explanation: 小天鹅, 小天鹅. The cygnet swan followed its mother across the lake. 小天鹅跟着母亲游过湖面。 | cygne->天鹅（法语，拉丁cygnus），cygnet->小天鹅（cf. Swan Lake天鹅湖，Cygnus天鹅座） || 文化联想：中国湿地里跟着母天鹅游动的小天鹅最适合帮助记忆 cygnet，可以说 **a swan cygnet — “A swan cygnet may paddle closely behind its mother across a quiet wetland pond.”**

quiz.question: _______ cabinet
quiz.explanation: 橱柜; 内阁, 厨房橱柜. Store the dishes in the kitchen cabinet. 把盘子放在厨房橱柜里。 | cabinet->小房间（法语，cabin的指小词），cabinet->小储物间/内阁（cf. cabin小屋，cabinet内阁=在小房间开会） || 文化联想：中国厨房里放碗盘的橱柜最适合帮助记忆 cabinet，可以说 **a kitchen cabinet — “A family may store bowls, plates, and teacups in a kitchen cabinet above the counter.”**

quiz.question: _____________ sonnet
quiz.explanation: 十四行诗, 莎士比亚式十四行诗. Students analyzed a Shakespearean sonnet in class. 学生们在课堂上分析了一首莎士比亚式十四行诗。 | sonetto->小声音（意大利语，suono->声音），sonnet->小声音=十四行诗（cf. sound声音，sonic声音的，sonorous洪亮的） || 文化联想：sonnet 是西方十四行诗体，可用中国学生学习莎士比亚诗歌时来记忆，可以说 **a Shakespearean sonnet — “In an English-literature class, a Chinese student may analyze the rhyme scheme of a Shakespearean sonnet.”**

quiz.question: _____ cornet
quiz.explanation: 短号, 铜制短号. The musician played a bright brass cornet. 音乐家演奏了一支明亮的铜制短号。 | corn->角（拉丁cornu），cornet->小号角=短号（cf. corner角落，unicorn独角兽，cornucopia丰饶角） || 文化联想：中国学校管乐团里的短号最适合帮助记忆 cornet，可以说 **a brass cornet — “A student in a school brass band may play a brass cornet with a bright, compact sound.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ trumpet
quiz.explanation: 小号; 喇叭, 吹小号. The herald will blow the trumpet to announce the king. 传令官将吹小号宣布国王到来。 | trump->小号（古法语trompe），trumpet->小的号角（cf. trump王牌/号角，trumpet vine凌霄花） || 文化联想：中国军乐队吹响小号的画面最适合帮助记忆 trumpet，可以说 **blow the trumpet — “At a ceremonial performance, a musician may blow the trumpet to produce a clear, ringing call.”**

quiz.question: ______ minaret
quiz.explanation: 宣礼塔, 清真寺宣礼塔. The mosque minaret towered over the city skyline. 清真寺宣礼塔高耸于城市天际线之上。 | manara->灯塔（阿拉伯语，来自nar->火），minaret->召唤祈祷的塔楼=宣礼塔（cf. manor庄园，cf. beacon灯塔） || 文化联想：新疆清真寺建筑中的宣礼塔最适合帮助记忆 minaret，可以说 **a mosque minaret — “A mosque minaret may rise above the surrounding rooftops as a distinctive part of Islamic architecture.”**

quiz.question: _____ garret
quiz.explanation: 阁楼, 阁楼. The artist lived in a small attic garret. 艺术家住在一个小阁楼里。 | garite->守望台（古法语），garret->屋顶下的小房间=阁楼（cf. garrison驻军，garret贫穷艺术家居住的象征） || 文化联想：老上海顶层狭小阁楼里住着穷艺术家的想象最适合帮助记忆 garret，可以说 **an attic garret — “A struggling artist in an old novel may rent a tiny attic garret beneath the roof.”**

quiz.question: ______ turret
quiz.explanation: 塔楼; 炮塔, 城堡塔楼. Guards watched from the castle turret. 卫兵从城堡塔楼上观察。 | tur->塔（拉丁turris），turret->小塔楼/炮塔（cf. tower塔，turret gun炮塔，tournament锦标赛=在塔旁边比武） || 文化联想：turret 是欧洲城堡常见的小塔楼，可用中国学生看西方城堡建筑时来记忆，可以说 **a castle turret — “A Chinese traveler visiting a European castle may climb a narrow stairway inside a castle turret.”**

quiz.question: beset __ ________
quiz.explanation: 困扰; 包围, 被问题困扰. The project was beset by problems from the start. 该项目从一开始就被问题困扰。 | be->使，set->设置/包围，beset->从四周设置包围=困扰（cf. besiege围攻，beleaguer围困，beset with difficulties） || 文化联想：中文“内忧外患、问题缠身”最适合帮助记忆 beset，可以说 **beset by problems — “A company facing debt, lawsuits, and falling sales may be beset by problems on every side.”**

quiz.question: offset _____
quiz.explanation: 抵消; 补偿, 抵消成本. Increased revenue will offset costs of expansion. 增加的收入将抵消扩张成本。 | off->对应，set->放置，offset->在对面放置以平衡=抵消（cf. onset开始=向前冲，offset印刷=偏移） || 文化联想：中文“用新增收入抵消成本”最适合帮助记忆 offset，可以说 **offset costs — “Higher ticket sales may offset costs created by expanding a theater production.”**

quiz.question: backset _____
quiz.explanation: 挫折; 后退, 后嵌式铰链. The carpenter installed a backset hinge on the door. 木匠在门上安装了后嵌式铰链。 | back->向后，set->放置，backset->向后设置的（cf. setback挫折，onset开始，offset抵消） || 文化联想：传统木匠安装门铰链的场景最适合帮助记忆 backset，可以说 **a backset hinge — “A carpenter may install a backset hinge so the door sits at the correct distance from the frame.”**

quiz.question: onset __ _______
quiz.explanation: 开始; 发作, 疾病的发作. The onset of illness was sudden and unexpected. 疾病的发作是突然且出乎意料的。 | on->向前，set->冲/放置，onset->向前冲=开始/发作（cf. offset抵消，setback挫折，outset起始） || 文化联想：中文“发病初期”最适合帮助记忆 onset，可以说 **the onset of illness — “A patient may remember that the onset of illness began with a sudden fever and fatigue.”**

quiz.question: ____-__ closet
quiz.explanation: 壁橱, 步入式衣橱. The master bedroom has a large walk-in closet. 主卧室有一个大的步入式衣橱。 | clos->关闭（拉丁clausum），closet->关闭的小房间=壁橱（cf. close关闭，enclose围住，disclose披露） || 文化联想：中国新房主卧里的步入式衣橱最适合帮助记忆 closet，可以说 **a walk-in closet — “A large apartment may include a walk-in closet with shelves, drawers, and hanging space.”**

quiz.question: cosset _ _____
quiz.explanation: 宠爱; 娇养, 宠爱孩子. Parents should not cosset a child too much. 父母不应该过度宠爱孩子。 | cosset->宠爱的羔羊（来自cot->小屋，圈养的），cosset->过度娇养（cf. mollycoddle溺爱，pamper宠坏） || 文化联想：中文“捧在手心里宠、过度娇养”最适合帮助记忆 cosset，可以说 **cosset a child — “Parents who solve every small problem for their son may cosset the child so much that independence becomes harder.”**

quiz.question: ______ quartet
quiz.explanation: 四重奏; 四重唱, 弦乐四重奏. The string quartet performed Beethovens masterpiece. 弦乐四重奏演奏了贝多芬的杰作。 | quart->四（拉丁quartus），quartet->四人组合=四重奏（cf. quarter四分之一，quart夸脱，quarterly季度） || 文化联想：中国音乐学院里的弦乐四重奏最适合帮助记忆 quartet，可以说 **a string quartet — “Four conservatory students may form a string quartet with two violins, a viola, and a cello.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ duet
quiz.explanation: 二重唱; 二重奏, 唱二重唱. The two singers will sing a duet at the concert. 两位歌手将在音乐会上唱二重唱。 | du->二（拉丁duo），duet->两人表演=二重奏（cf. dual双重，duo二人组，duplicate复制，duel决斗=两人对决） || 文化联想：春晚或音乐会里两位歌手合唱最适合帮助记忆 duet，可以说 **sing a duet — “Two singers may sing a duet together during a televised New Year concert.”**

quiz.question: _____ minuet
quiz.explanation: 小步舞曲, 宫廷小步舞. Nobles danced the elegant court minuet. 贵族跳优雅的宫廷小步舞。 | menu->小（法语menu->细小），minuet->小步的舞蹈=小步舞曲（cf. minute微小/分钟，menu菜单=细小的清单） || 文化联想：minuet 是欧洲宫廷舞曲，可用中国音乐学生学习莫扎特作品时来记忆，可以说 **a court minuet — “A Chinese music student may learn how a court minuet uses an elegant triple meter and measured dance rhythm.”**

quiz.question: _____ tourniquet
quiz.explanation: 止血带, 使用止血带. The medic will apply tourniquet to stop bleeding. 医务人员将使用止血带止血。 | tourniquet->转动装置（法语tourner->转），tourniquet->转紧以止血的带子=止血带（cf. turn转，tournament锦标赛） || 文化联想：中国急救培训里学习大出血时使用止血带最适合帮助记忆 tourniquet，可以说 **apply a tourniquet — “In first-aid training, students learn when and how to apply a tourniquet for life-threatening limb bleeding.”**

quiz.question: _____ banquet
quiz.explanation: 宴会, 国宴. The president hosted a state banquet for foreign dignitaries. 总统为外国政要举办了国宴。 | banc->长凳（意大利语banco），banquet->在长凳上进餐=宴会（cf. bank银行=长桌，bench长凳，banquet原指在凳子上的小聚） || 文化联想：中文“国宴”最适合帮助记忆 banquet，可以说 **a state banquet — “Visiting foreign leaders may be welcomed with a formal state banquet featuring carefully planned dishes and protocol.”**

quiz.question: ___ parquet
quiz.explanation: 镶木地板, 橡木镶木地板. The ballroom features beautiful oak parquet flooring. 舞厅有漂亮的橡木镶木地板。 | parc->小围栏（法语），parquet->小方格地板=镶木地板（cf. park公园，parking停车=围起来的地方） || 文化联想：老上海舞厅或历史建筑里人字拼木地板最适合帮助记忆 parquet，可以说 **oak parquet — “A restored ballroom may preserve its original oak parquet arranged in an elegant geometric pattern.”**

quiz.question: ______ bouquet
quiz.explanation: 花束, 新娘花束. She carried a beautiful bridal bouquet of roses. 她拿着一束美丽的玫瑰新娘花束。 | bosquet->小树丛（法语），bouquet->一束花=花束（cf. bush灌木丛，bouquet同根，aroma香气） || 文化联想：中国现代婚礼里新娘手捧鲜花最适合帮助记忆 bouquet，可以说 **a bridal bouquet — “A bride may carry a bridal bouquet of roses and peonies during the wedding ceremony.”**

quiz.question: rivet _________
quiz.explanation: 铆钉; 吸引, 吸引注意力. The speakers story will rivet attention of the audience. 演讲者的故事将吸引观众的注意力。 | rivet->铆钉（古法语river->固定），rivet->用铆钉固定/吸引注意（riveting=令人目不转睛的，cf. rivet铆钉，arrive到达） || 文化联想：中文“牢牢吸引注意力、让人目不转睛”最适合帮助记忆 rivet，可以说 **rivet the audience’s attention — “A suspenseful storyteller can rivet the audience’s attention from the opening sentence to the final twist.”**

quiz.question: covet ______
quiz.explanation: 垂涎; 觊觎, 觊觎财富. Do not covet wealth that belongs to others. 不要觊觎属于别人的财富。 | cupidus->渴望的（拉丁，来自cupere），covet->热切渴望他人之物（cf. cupid丘比特=欲望之神，cupidity贪婪，cover覆盖） || 文化联想：中文“觊觎别人的财富”最适合帮助记忆 covet，可以说 **covet wealth — “Someone who constantly envies a neighbor’s fortune may begin to covet wealth that does not belong to him.”**

quiz.question: daft ____
quiz.explanation: 愚蠢的; 疯狂的, 愚蠢的想法. Thats a daft idea that will never work. 那是一个永远行不通的愚蠢想法。 | daft->温顺/愚蠢（古英语gedæfte->温顺），daft->愚蠢的（英式俚语，cf. dumb哑/愚蠢，silly愚蠢） || 文化联想：中文“馊主意”最适合帮助记忆 daft，可以说 **a daft idea — “Trying to fix a leaking roof by simply painting over the stain would be a daft idea.”**

quiz.question: ______ haft
quiz.explanation: 柄; 把, 锤柄. The hammer haft was made of sturdy wood. 锤柄由坚固的木头制成。 | haft->柄（古英语hæft），haft->刀/斧/锤的柄（cf. haft vs. handle，helve斧柄，hilt剑柄） || 文化联想：中国木工工具中锤子的木柄最适合帮助记忆 haft，可以说 **a hammer haft — “A craftsman may replace a cracked hammer haft with a sturdy piece of hardwood.”**

quiz.question: _____ draft
quiz.explanation: 草稿; 汇票, 初稿. The writer completed the first draft of the novel. 作家完成了小说的初稿。 | draft->拉/牵引（古英语dragan），draft->拉出的草图=草稿（cf. drag拖，draw画/拉，draft beer生啤=从桶里拉出的） || 文化联想：中国学生写作文时先完成初稿最适合帮助记忆 draft，可以说 **a first draft — “A student may finish a first draft of an essay and revise the wording several times before submission.”**

quiz.question: graft _______
quiz.explanation: 贪污; 移植, 贪污丑闻. The politician was involved in a major graft scandal. 这位政客卷入了一起重大贪污丑闻。 | graphion->书写工具（希腊），graft->嫁接（切口形似笔头），graft->嫁接/贪污（cf. graph图表，graphic图形） || 文化联想：中文“贪污受贿丑闻”最适合帮助记忆 graft，可以说 **a graft scandal — “An official secretly taking kickbacks from contractors may become the center of a graft scandal.”**

quiz.question: deft _____
quiz.explanation: 灵巧的; 熟练的, 灵巧的手法. The artist worked with a deft touch. 艺术家以灵巧的手法工作。 | deft->灵巧的（古英语gedæfte->温顺/合适），deft->轻巧熟练的（cf. adept熟练，adroit灵巧=右手朝向的，deft轻盈） || 文化联想：苏绣工匠轻巧熟练的针法最适合帮助记忆 deft，可以说 **a deft touch — “A Suzhou embroiderer needs a deft touch to place tiny stitches without damaging delicate silk.”**

quiz.question: ____ cleft
quiz.explanation: 裂缝; 裂口, 岩石裂缝. Water seeped through the rock cleft. 水从岩石裂缝中渗出。 | cleave->劈开（古英语cleofan），cleft->被劈开的裂口（cf. cleave劈开/紧附，cleft palate腭裂，cloven hoof劈蹄） || 文化联想：华山岩壁中狭窄裂缝最适合帮助记忆 cleft，可以说 **a rock cleft — “Rainwater may collect in a narrow rock cleft high on a mountain slope.”**

quiz.question: bereft __ ____
quiz.explanation: 失去; 丧失, 失去希望. The refugees felt bereft of hope. 难民感到失去了希望。 | be->使，reave->夺去（古英语），bereft->被夺去的=失去的（cf. bereave夺去，bereavement丧亲，reave掠夺） || 文化联想：中文“失去希望、心里空了一块”最适合帮助记忆 bereft，可以说 **bereft of hope — “After repeated failures and no sign of help, a displaced family may feel bereft of hope.”**

quiz.question: ______ rift
quiz.explanation: 裂痕; 分歧, 家庭裂痕. The argument caused a family rift that lasted years. 这场争吵造成了持续多年的家庭裂痕。 | rift->裂缝（古挪威ript->破裂），rift->裂痕/分歧（cf. rife普遍，rip撕裂，rift valley裂谷） || 文化联想：中文“兄弟反目、家庭出现裂痕”最适合帮助记忆 rift，可以说 **a family rift — “A bitter inheritance dispute can create a family rift that lasts for many years.”**

quiz.question: snowdrift _______
quiz.explanation: 雪堆, 雪堆屏障. The snowdrift barrier blocked the mountain road. 雪堆屏障堵住了山路。 | snow->雪，drift->漂流/堆积，snowdrift->风吹积聚的雪堆（cf. drift漂流，adrift漂泊，driftwood漂流木） || 文化联想：东北暴雪后公路旁被风吹起的巨大雪堆最适合帮助记忆 snowdrift，可以说 **a snowdrift barrier — “After a blizzard, a deep snowdrift may block a rural road until plows arrive.”**

quiz.question: spendthrift ______
quiz.explanation: 挥霍者; 浪费的, 挥霍习惯. His spendthrift habits left him deeply in debt. 他的挥霍习惯使他债台高筑。 | spend->花费，thrift->节约（来自thrive繁荣），spendthrift->把节约都花掉的人=挥霍者（cf. thrift节约，thrifty节俭） || 文化联想：中文“大手大脚、寅吃卯粮”最适合帮助记忆 spendthrift，可以说 **spendthrift habits — “Someone who spends each paycheck immediately and keeps borrowing for luxuries may develop spendthrift habits.”**

quiz.question: sift ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 筛; 细查, 筛选数据. Researchers must sift the data carefully for patterns. 研究人员必须仔细筛选数据寻找模式。 | sift->过筛（古英语siftan），sift->用筛子筛/仔细筛查（cf. sieve筛子，sift through仔细搜查） || 文化联想：中文“从海量数据里一层层筛出有用信息”最适合帮助记忆 sift，可以说 **sift the data — “A researcher may sift the data carefully until a meaningful pattern emerges from thousands of records.”**

quiz.question: loft _________
quiz.explanation: 阁楼, 阁楼公寓. The artist lives in a spacious loft apartment. 这位艺术家住在一间宽敞的阁楼公寓里。 | loft->空中/阁楼（古挪威lopt->空气/阁楼），loft->顶层/阁楼（cf. aloft在高处，lift电梯，lofty崇高） || 文化联想：中国旧厂房改造成挑高阁楼公寓最适合帮助记忆 loft，可以说 **a loft apartment — “A converted factory building may contain a spacious loft apartment with high ceilings and exposed beams.”**

quiz.question: sleight __ ____
quiz.explanation: 巧妙手法; 戏法, 手法. The magician performed amazing sleight of hand tricks. 魔术师表演了惊人的手法戏法。 | sleight->狡猾（古挪威sloegr->狡猾），sleight of hand->手的狡猾=变戏法（注意不是slight，cf. slight轻微） || 文化联想：中国魔术表演里的手上戏法最适合帮助记忆 sleight，可以说 **sleight of hand — “A magician may use sleight of hand to make a coin seem to disappear from an empty palm.”**

quiz.question: freight _____
quiz.explanation: 货运; 货物, 货运火车. The freight train carried goods across the country. 货运火车将货物运往全国各地。 | vracht->船货（荷兰语），freight->运输的货物（cf. fraught充满=装满货物，freight train货运列车） || 文化联想：中欧班列运输货物最适合帮助记忆 freight，可以说 **a freight train — “A freight train may carry containers from inland China toward markets thousands of kilometers away.”**

quiz.question: ____ blight
quiz.explanation: 枯萎病; 祸患, 作物枯萎病. The crop blight destroyed entire harvests. 作物枯萎病摧毁了整个收成。 | blight->枯萎（来源不明），blight->使枯萎/破坏（cf. blight urban blight城市凋敝，blighted area衰败地区） || 文化联想：中国农田遇到严重病害导致庄稼大片枯死最适合帮助记忆 blight，可以说 **crop blight — “A fast-spreading crop blight can destroy a farmer’s harvest if it is not controlled quickly.”**

quiz.question: ______ flight
quiz.explanation: 航班; 飞行, 返程航班. Book your return flight in advance. 提前预订您的返程航班。 | flight->飞行（古英语flyht），flight->飞行/逃跑（cf. fly飞，flee逃跑，flight of stairs一段楼梯） || 文化联想：春运结束后提前预订返程航班最适合帮助记忆 flight，可以说 **a return flight — “After spending Spring Festival with family, a traveler may take a return flight back to the city where she works.”**

quiz.question: slight ______
quiz.explanation: 轻微的; 微小的, 轻微的伤害. He suffered only a slight injury in the accident. 他在事故中只受了轻微的伤害。 | slight->轻微/轻视（古挪威sletta->平坦），slight->轻微的/轻视（cf. slight轻视，slender纤细，slim苗条） || 文化联想：中文“只是轻微擦伤”最适合帮助记忆 slight，可以说 **a slight injury — “A cyclist who falls at low speed may escape with only a slight injury to the knee.”**

quiz.question: forthright ______
quiz.explanation: 直率的; 坦诚的, 直率的方式. She spoke in a forthright manner about the issues. 她以直率的方式谈论这些问题。 | forth->向前，right->直，forthright->直接向前=直率的（cf. forthcoming即将到来，upright正直，outright彻底） || 文化联想：中文“打开天窗说亮话”最适合帮助记忆 forthright，可以说 **a forthright manner — “A manager who explains bad news directly instead of hiding it speaks in a forthright manner.”**

quiz.question: upright _______
quiz.explanation: 直立的; 正直的, 直立的姿势. Maintain an upright posture while sitting. 坐着时保持直立的姿势。 | up->向上，right->直，upright->笔直向上的=直立/正直（cf. forthright直率，outright彻底，downright彻头彻尾） || 文化联想：中文“站如松”最适合帮助记忆 upright，可以说 **an upright posture — “Traditional advice to ‘站如松’ encourages an upright posture with the body held straight and balanced.”**

quiz.question: ______ shipwright
quiz.explanation: 造船工匠, 大师级造船工匠. The master shipwright built vessels for decades. 大师级造船工匠建造船只数十年。 | ship->船，wright->工匠（古英语wryhta），shipwright->造船工匠（cf. playwright剧作家，wheelwright制轮匠，wainwright制马车匠） || 文化联想：郑和船队背后的造船工匠最适合帮助记忆 shipwright，可以说 **a master shipwright — “A master shipwright in a major Ming-era dockyard would have needed deep knowledge of timber, hulls, joints, and rigging.”**

quiz.question: __________ foresight
quiz.explanation: 远见; 先见之明, 非凡的远见. His remarkable foresight predicted market trends. 他非凡的远见预测了市场趋势。 | fore->提前，sight->视力，foresight->提前看到=远见（cf. oversight疏忽，hindsight事后诸葛，insight洞察力） || 文化联想：中文“未雨绸缪”最适合帮助记忆 foresight，可以说 **remarkable foresight — “Building flood defenses before a disaster arrives shows remarkable foresight—正所谓‘未雨绸缪.’”**

quiz.question: _____ oversight
quiz.explanation: 疏忽; 监督, 重大疏忽. The error was a major oversight in planning. 这个错误是规划中的重大疏忽。 | over->在上，sight->看，oversight->俯视监督/看漏了=监督/疏忽（cf. foresight远见，hindsight事后，insight洞察） || 文化联想：中文“百密一疏”最适合帮助记忆 oversight，可以说 **a major oversight — “Forgetting to check a crucial safety valve can become a major oversight even in an otherwise careful plan.”**

quiz.question: airtight ____
quiz.explanation: 密封的, 密封. The container has an airtight seal to preserve freshness. 容器有密封以保持新鲜。 | air->空气，tight->紧，airtight->连空气都不能通过的=密封的（cf. watertight不透水，hermetically sealed密封） || 文化联想：中国茶叶罐强调防潮密封最适合帮助记忆 airtight，可以说 **an airtight seal — “A tea container needs an airtight seal to keep moisture and outside odors away from the leaves.”**

quiz.question: ______ onslaught
quiz.explanation: 猛攻; 冲击, 残酷的猛攻. The army faced a brutal onslaught from the enemy. 军队面临敌人残酷的猛攻。 | on->向前，slaught->打击（古荷兰語slacht->屠杀），onslaught->向前猛烈打击=猛攻（cf. slaughter屠杀，onset开始） || 文化联想：中文“迎面而来的猛烈冲击”最适合帮助记忆 onslaught，可以说 **a brutal onslaught — “A defensive line may collapse under a brutal onslaught if wave after wave of attacks continues without pause.”**

quiz.question: fraught ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 充满的; 担忧的, 充满风险. The venture is fraught with risk and uncertainty. 这项冒险充满风险和不确定性。 | fraught->装满货物的（freight的过去式），fraught->满载着=充满（cf. freight货物，fraught with意味着充满） || 文化联想：中文“如履薄冰、充满风险”最适合帮助记忆 fraught，可以说 **fraught with risk — “A heavily leveraged investment can be fraught with risk when markets turn sharply downward.”**

quiz.question: ______ drought
quiz.explanation: 干旱, 严重干旱. The region experienced a severe drought for months. 该地区经历了数月的严重干旱。 | drugie->干燥（古英语dragan），drought->干燥状态=干旱（cf. dry干燥，drain排水，drought注意gh不发音） || 文化联想：华北长期少雨导致农田缺水最适合帮助记忆 drought，可以说 **a severe drought — “A severe drought can lower reservoir levels and threaten crops across a farming region.”**

quiz.question: ____ wrought
quiz.explanation: 锻造的; 精心制作的, 手工锻造的. The gate was made of hand wrought iron. 大门由手工锻造的铁制成。 | wrought->work的古英语过去式，wrought->精心制作的（cf. work工作，overwork过度工作，wrought iron熟铁） || 文化联想：中国传统铁匠手工锻造铁门最适合帮助记忆 wrought，可以说 **hand-wrought iron — “A traditional blacksmith may shape hand-wrought iron into hinges, gates, and decorative fittings.”**

quiz.question: overwrought ______
quiz.explanation: 过度紧张的; 过分修饰的, 过度紧张的神经. Her overwrought nerves needed rest. 她过度紧张的神经需要休息。 | over->过度，wrought->加工，overwrought->过度加工/紧张=过度紧张的（cf. wrought iron熟铁，overwrought状态） || 文化联想：中文“高考前紧张过头、神经绷得太紧”最适合帮助记忆 overwrought，可以说 **overwrought nerves — “A student who has barely slept before an important exam may arrive with overwrought nerves.”**

quiz.question: _______ gait
quiz.explanation: 步态; 步法, 笨拙的步态. He walked with an awkward gait after the injury. 受伤后他走路的步态很笨拙。 | gate->道路（古挪威gat->通道），gait->走路的方式=步态（cf. gate大门，gait步态，注意gate/gait同音） || 文化联想：老人膝盖受伤后走路一瘸一拐最适合帮助记忆 gait，可以说 **an awkward gait — “After a knee injury, an older adult may develop an awkward gait until strength and balance recover.”**

quiz.question: _______ trait
quiz.explanation: 特征; 特性, 遗传特征. Eye color is determined by genetic trait. 眼睛颜色由遗传特征决定。 | trait->拉出（法语traire->拉），trait->拉出来显现的特征（cf. tract大片，portrait肖像=向前画，betray出卖） || 文化联想：孩子像父母一样有酒窝最适合帮助记忆 trait，可以说 **a genetic trait — “A dimple that appears in several generations of a family can be discussed as a genetic trait.”**

quiz.question: distrait ______
quiz.explanation: 心不在焉的, 心不在焉的态度. She answered in a distrait manner, clearly preoccupied. 她以心不在焉的态度回答,显然心事重重。 | dis->分开，trait->拉，distrait->注意力被拉走的=心不在焉的（cf. distract分心，distraught极度烦恼，absent-minded） || 文化联想：中文“魂不守舍、心不在焉”最适合帮助记忆 distrait，可以说 **a distrait manner — “Someone worried about a family problem may answer questions in a distrait manner because the mind is elsewhere.”**

quiz.question: _ bit ____
quiz.explanation: 一点; 少量, 一个小角色. He played a bit part in the movie. 他在电影中扮演了一个小角色。 | bit->一小块（古英语bita->咬的一口），bit part->极小的角色（cf. bit钻头/比特/一点，bite咬，a bit有点） || 文化联想：中文影视里“跑龙套的小角色”最适合帮助记忆 bit，可以说 **a bit part — “A young actor may begin a career with a bit part that appears on screen for only a few seconds.”**

quiz.question: inhabit _____
quiz.explanation: 居住; 栖息, 居住在洞穴. Ancient peoples used to inhabit caves. 古代人曾经居住在洞穴中。 | in->在内，habit->居住（拉丁habitare），inhabit->在里面居住=栖息（cf. habitat栖息地，habit习惯，cohabit同居） || 文化联想：桂林喀斯特洞穴里的蝙蝠最适合帮助记忆 inhabit，可以说 **inhabit caves — “Several bat species inhabit caves in karst landscapes and emerge after sunset to feed.”**

quiz.question: cohabit ____
quiz.explanation: 同居, 与...同居. The couple chose to cohabit with each other before marriage. 这对夫妇选择在婚前与对方同居。 | co->共同，habit->居住，cohabit->共同居住=同居（cf. inhabit居住，habitat栖息地，habitual习惯的） || 文化联想：中国年轻情侣婚前一起租房生活最适合帮助记忆 cohabit，可以说 **cohabit with a partner — “Some couples choose to cohabit with a partner before marriage and share the same household.”**

quiz.question: inhibit ______
quiz.explanation: 抑制; 阻止, 抑制生长. Lack of sunlight will inhibit growth of plants. 缺乏阳光会抑制植物的生长。 | in->进入/阻止，hibit->持有（拉丁habere），inhibit->阻止持续=抑制（cf. exhibit展示，prohibit禁止，inhibition抑制） || 文化联想：缺少阳光会抑制植物生长，最适合帮助记忆 inhibit，可以说 **inhibit growth — “Keeping a sun-loving plant in deep shade can inhibit growth and weaken new leaves.”**

quiz.question: tacit _______
quiz.explanation: 心照不宣的; 默许的, 默许. Their tacit consent was understood without words. 他们的默许无需言语就能理解。 | tacit->沉默（拉丁tacere->沉默），tacit->不言而喻的=心照不宣（cf. taciturn沉默寡言的，reticent沉默的） || 文化联想：中文“心照不宣”最适合帮助记忆 tacit，可以说 **tacit consent — “When everyone silently accepts an arrangement without saying yes aloud, there may be tacit consent—也就是‘心照不宣.’”**

quiz.question: ______ deficit
quiz.explanation: 赤字; 不足, 预算赤字. The government faces a large budget deficit. 政府面临巨大的预算赤字。 | de->向下，ficit->做（拉丁facere），deficit->做不够=不足/赤字（cf. defect缺陷，efficient有效，suffice足够） || 文化联想：中文“预算赤字”最适合帮助记忆 deficit，可以说 **a budget deficit — “When annual spending exceeds revenue, a government or company may report a budget deficit.”**

quiz.question: licit _____
quiz.explanation: 合法的, 合法贸易. The business engaged in licit trade activities. 该企业从事合法贸易活动。 | licet->被允许（拉丁），licit->合法允许的（cf. illicit非法，elicit引出，solicit征求，license许可） || 文化联想：中文“合法合规的贸易”最适合帮助记忆 licit，可以说 **licit trade — “Customs enforcement tries to separate smuggling from licit trade conducted through lawful channels.”**

quiz.question: elicit ________
quiz.explanation: 引出; 诱出, 引出回应. The question will elicit response from the audience. 这个问题将引出观众的回应。 | e->向外，licit->引出（拉丁elicere），elicit->向外引出=诱导引出（cf. licit合法，illicit非法，solicit征求，cf. elicit≠illicit） || 文化联想：中文“抛砖引玉、把大家的话引出来”最适合帮助记忆 elicit，可以说 **elicit a response — “A teacher may ask an open-ended question to elicit a response from students who have been quiet.”**

quiz.question: illicit _____
quiz.explanation: 非法的, 非法贸易. Police cracked down on illicit trade networks. 警方打击非法贸易网络。 | il->否定，licit->合法，illicit->不合法的（cf. licit合法，elicit引出，注意illicit/elicit容易混淆） || 文化联想：中文“地下非法交易”最适合帮助记忆 illicit，可以说 **illicit trade — “Police may investigate an illicit trade network selling goods through hidden channels.”**

quiz.question: solicit _________
quiz.explanation: 恳求; 征求, 征求捐款. The charity will solicit donations for disaster relief. 慈善机构将为救灾征求捐款。 | sol->全部，cit->引动（拉丁citare），solicit->全力引动=殷勤恳求（cf. solicitous体贴，solicitor律师，cite引用） || 文化联想：中国公益机构公开征集救灾捐款最适合帮助记忆 solicit，可以说 **solicit donations — “A charity may solicit donations from the public after a major flood.”**

quiz.question: implicit ____
quiz.explanation: 含蓄的; 隐含的, 隐含偏见. Everyone has some form of implicit bias. 每个人都有某种形式的隐含偏见。 | im->进入，plic->折叠（拉丁），implicit->折叠进去隐含的（cf. explicit明确展开的，implicate牵连，imply暗示） || 文化联想：中文“自己都没意识到的偏见”最适合帮助记忆 implicit，可以说 **implicit bias — “A hiring decision can be influenced by implicit bias even when the interviewer believes the process is completely neutral.”**

quiz.question: explicit ____________
quiz.explanation: 明确的; 清楚的, 明确的指示. Follow the explicit instructions carefully. 仔细遵循明确的指示。 | ex->向外，plic->折叠，explicit->折叠展开=明确的（cf. implicit隐含，implicate牵连，explain解释=展开） || 文化联想：中文“白纸黑字写得清清楚楚”最适合帮助记忆 explicit，可以说 **explicit instructions — “A safety manual should provide explicit instructions so workers do not have to guess what to do.”**

quiz.question: ___ plaudit
quiz.explanation: 赞扬; 喝彩, 赢得赞扬. The performance will win plaudit from critics. 这场演出将赢得评论家的赞扬。 | plaud->鼓掌（拉丁plaudere），plaudit->鼓掌喝彩=赞扬（cf. applaud鼓掌，applause掌声，explode爆炸=originally=鼓掌轰下台） || 文化联想：中文“赢得满堂彩”最适合帮助记忆 plaudit，可以说 **win plaudits — “A brilliant Peking-opera performance may win plaudits from critics and audiences alike.”**

quiz.question: albeit _____
quiz.explanation: 虽然; 尽管, 虽然小. It was a victory, albeit small. 这是一场胜利,虽然很小。 | albeit->虽然（al=all be it=尽管如此），albeit->尽管（cf. although虽然，even though尽管，albeit更正式） || 文化联想：中文“虽小，但也是进步”最适合帮助记忆 albeit，可以说 **a victory, albeit small — “Completing the first difficult step is a victory, albeit small, and can build confidence for the next one.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ deceit
quiz.explanation: 欺骗; 诡计, 欺骗行为. The lie was an act of deceit. 这个谎言是欺骗行为。 | de->向下，ceit->抓取（拉丁capere），deceit->向下抓取=欺骗（cf. receive接收，perceive感知，deceive欺骗=向下拉） || 文化联想：中文“尔虞我诈”最适合帮助记忆 deceit，可以说 **an act of deceit — “Using a fake identity to gain another person’s trust is an act of deceit.”**

quiz.question: ______ conceit
quiz.explanation: 自负; 巧妙的比喻, 诗意的比喻. The poem uses an elaborate poetic conceit. 这首诗使用了一个精心设计的诗意比喻。 | con->共同，ceit->抓取/构思，conceit->共同构思=自负/文学巧喻（cf. conceive构思，receipt收据，perceive感知） || 文化联想：conceit 在这里是西方诗歌里的精巧比喻，可用中国学生学习英语诗歌时来记忆，可以说 **a poetic conceit — “In an English-literature class, students may analyze a poetic conceit that develops an elaborate comparison across several lines.”**

quiz.question: counterfeit ____
quiz.explanation: 伪造的; 假冒的, 伪钞. Police seized the counterfeit bill during the raid. 警方在突袭中缴获了伪钞。 | counter->对抗，feit->做（拉丁facere），counterfeit->反向做=伪造的（cf. perfect完美，deficit赤字，forfeit没收） || 文化联想：中文“假钞、山寨货”最适合帮助记忆 counterfeit，可以说 **a counterfeit bill — “A cashier may use security features to distinguish a genuine banknote from a counterfeit bill.”**

quiz.question: surfeit __ ____
quiz.explanation: 过量; 过度, 过量食物. The feast provided a surfeit of food. 宴会提供了过量的食物。 | sur->超过，feit->做，surfeit->过度做/过量（cf. surplus过剩，surpass超过，surfeit vs. excess同义） || 文化联想：中文“年夜饭菜多到吃不完”最适合帮助记忆 surfeit，可以说 **a surfeit of food — “A huge reunion dinner may leave the table with a surfeit of food long after everyone is full.”**

quiz.question: discomfit _____
quiz.explanation: 使困惑; 使挫败, 挫败敌人. The strategy will discomfit enemy forces. 这个策略将挫败敌军。 | dis->否定，comfit->舒适/打败（古法语confire->击败），discomfit->使不舒适/挫败（注意：discomfit≠discomfort，更强烈） || 文化联想：中文“让对手措手不及、狼狈不堪”最适合帮助记忆 discomfit，可以说 **discomfit an opponent — “An unexpected move in a Go match may discomfit an opponent and disrupt a carefully prepared strategy.”**

quiz.question: ___ _ whit
quiz.explanation: 一点; 少许, 一点也不. He cared not a whit about the consequences. 他对后果一点也不在乎。 | whit->极小的量（古英语wiht->东西），not a whit->连一点点都不（cf. iota一点点=希腊字母最小，jot一点） || 文化联想：中文“一点儿也不在乎”最适合帮助记忆 whit，可以说 **not a whit — “Someone determined to continue may care not a whit about gossip or criticism.”**

quiz.question: _____ skit
quiz.explanation: 幽默短剧; 滑稽表演, 喜剧小品. The actors performed a comic skit on stage. 演员们在舞台上表演了一个喜剧小品。 | skit->讽刺短剧（古挪威skjota->射/快速移动），skit->讽刺小品（cf. sketch素描/速写小品，skit轻松讽刺） || 文化联想：中国人最熟悉的“春晚小品”最适合帮助记忆 skit，可以说 **a comic skit — “A television gala may include a comic skit built around everyday family misunderstandings.”**

quiz.question: split _____
quiz.explanation: 分裂; 劈开, 吹毛求疵. Do not split hairs over minor details. 不要在小细节上吹毛求疵。 | split->劈开（荷兰语splitten），split hairs->把毛发都劈开=吹毛求疵（cf. cleave劈，split decision分歧裁决） || 文化联想：中文“吹毛求疵、抠字眼”最适合帮助记忆 split，可以说 **split hairs — “Arguing for twenty minutes over a tiny wording difference may be little more than trying to split hairs.”**

quiz.question: remit _______
quiz.explanation: 汇款; 宽恕, 汇款. Please remit payment within 30 days. 请在30天内汇款。 | re->回，mit->送（拉丁mittere），remit->送回/汇款（cf. submit提交，commit承诺，transmit传输，emit发射） || 文化联想：中国家庭向海外亲友汇款最适合帮助记忆 remit，可以说 **remit payment — “A family may remit payment through a bank when sending money to a relative studying abroad.”**

quiz.question: delimit ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 划定界限, 界定范围. We need to delimit the scope of the project. 我们需要界定项目的范围。 | de->彻底，limit->限制，delimit->划清界限=界定（cf. limit限制，unlimited无限，delimiter分隔符） || 文化联想：中文“先把项目边界划清楚”最适合帮助记忆 delimit，可以说 **delimit the scope — “Before development begins, a project team should delimit the scope so everyone knows what is included and excluded.”**

quiz.question: ________ hermit
quiz.explanation: 隐士, 山中隐士. The mountain hermit lived alone for decades. 山中隐士独自生活了几十年。 | eremite->荒野居民（希腊eremos->荒漠），hermit->在荒野独居的人=隐士（cf. hermitage隐居处，hermetically密封=隐士式封闭） || 文化联想：中国传统文化里的终南山隐士最适合帮助记忆 hermit，可以说 **a mountain hermit — “A mountain hermit may withdraw from ordinary society and live alone in a remote valley.”**

quiz.question: transmit ____
quiz.explanation: 传输; 传播, 传输数据. The satellite will transmit data back to Earth. 卫星将把数据传输回地球。 | trans->跨越，mit->送，transmit->越过距离发送=传输（cf. submit提交，permit允许，emit发射，remit汇款） || 文化联想：北斗卫星把定位数据发送回地面系统最适合帮助记忆 transmit，可以说 **transmit data — “A satellite may transmit data to ground stations through radio signals.”**

quiz.question: manumit ______
quiz.explanation: 解放(奴隶), 解放奴隶. The owner decided to manumit slaves before the law required it. 主人决定在法律要求之前解放奴隶。 | manu->手，mit->送，manumit->从手中放开送走=解放奴隶（cf. manual手动，manufacture制造，manuscript手稿） || 文化联想：manumit 是西方奴隶制历史中的法律词，可用中国学生学习美国历史时来记忆，可以说 **manumit enslaved people — “In a class on slavery and emancipation, students may learn that an owner could legally manumit enslaved people under certain historical laws.”**

quiz.question: knit _ _______
quiz.explanation: 编织, 编织毛衣. She learned to knit a sweater for her grandson. 她学会了为孙子编织毛衣。 | knit->编织（古英语cnyttan->打结），knit->编织/紧密结合（cf. knot结，net网，knit one's brows皱眉） || 文化联想：中国奶奶给孙子织毛衣最适合帮助记忆 knit，可以说 **knit a sweater — “A grandmother may knit a sweater for her grandson one row at a time during the winter.”**

quiz.question: exploit ___________
quiz.explanation: 开发; 利用, 利用机会. Smart businesses exploit opportunity when it arises. 聪明的企业会在机会出现时加以利用。 | ex->向外，ploit->折叠（拉丁plicare），exploit->展开利用（cf. exploit功绩，implicit隐含，explicit明确，exploit可褒可贬） || 文化联想：中文“抓住机会、把机会用足”最适合帮助记忆 exploit，可以说 **exploit an opportunity — “A small company may exploit an opportunity quickly when a larger competitor leaves an important market gap.”**

quiz.question: adroit __________
quiz.explanation: 灵巧的; 机敏的, 机敏的谈判者. The adroit negotiator secured favorable terms. 机敏的谈判者获得了有利的条款。 | a->朝向，droit->右（法语，拉丁directus->直/右），adroit->朝向右手的=灵巧的（cf. dexterous灵巧=右手的，sinister左/邪恶） || 文化联想：中文“八面玲珑、谈判手腕灵活”最适合帮助记忆 adroit，可以说 **an adroit negotiator — “An adroit negotiator can protect core interests while finding language that allows both sides to save face.”**

quiz.question: maladroit ________
quiz.explanation: 笨拙的; 不灵巧的, 笨拙的处理. His maladroit handling of the situation made things worse. 他对局势的笨拙处理使情况变得更糟。 | mal->坏，adroit->灵巧，maladroit->不灵巧的=笨拙的（cf. adroit灵巧，dexterous右手灵，sinister左/邪恶） || 文化联想：中文“笨手笨脚、处理得很不高明”最适合帮助记忆 maladroit，可以说 **maladroit handling — “A manager who criticizes an employee publicly and then argues with the whole team may make the situation worse through maladroit handling.”**
